user.title: Set up Wattrio Energiefluss
user.description: Give your system a name. Then we go through it topic by topic – Wattrio looks for the matching sensors itself.

grid.title: Grid and house
grid.description: {found} This is what Wattrio found for the grid and the house consumption, with current values. Untick what does not fit.

data.grid_power: Pick the grid sensor yourself (+ import, − export)

solar.title: Solar
solar.description: Do you have a PV system?

solar_pick.title: Solar
solar_pick.description: {found} Every sensor becomes one field on the solar panel (e.g. per roof side or string).

battery.title: Battery storage
battery.description: Do you have one or more batteries?

battery_pick.title: Battery storage
battery_pick.description: {found} At most {max} batteries. "Probably the same battery" means a second integration sees the same battery – tick only one. You can add more later under Einstellungen.

backup.title: Backup power
backup.description: Are devices connected to a battery's backup output (e.g. an air conditioner on an EcoFlow)?

backup_pick.title: Backup power
backup_pick.description: Pick the battery and the power sensors of the devices on its backup output.

data.backup_only: Battery discharges only via backup (not into the house)

wallbox.title: Wallbox / EV
wallbox.description: Do you have a wallbox or charge an electric car?

tariff.title: Dynamic electricity tariff
tariff.description: Do you have a dynamic tariff (e.g. Tibber) with a price sensor?

look.title: Which look?
look.description: The card appears straight away on the **Wattrio** page at the top of the sidebar. You can switch the look there at any time.

error.too_many_batteries: At most {max} batteries – please untick some.
error.invalid_selection: This selection does not fit together – please untick one entry.
error.backup_only_needs_split: "Only via backup" needs separate charge and discharge sensors for that battery.

init.title: Edit Wattrio
init.description:
The system is edited in the visual editor: **[Open editor]({url})**

There is nothing else to set here.
